Class SecondaryMacroBlock

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.btf.ComponentBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.macroBlocks.SecondaryMacroBlock
Direct Known Subclasses:
XSecondaryMacroBlock, YSecondaryMacroBlock
public abstract class SecondaryMacroBlock extends ComponentBlock
This class is an abstract super class the implements the common featrues of the SecondaryMacroBlocks that are found in the X and Y blocks of the A matrix. methods for their initialisation and sub copying are implemented. The matrix is represented by a SparseBlockMatrix.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
